claim_assertions.claim_1: The annual margin and regional revenue reconciliations use the same currency comparison basis.
claim_assertions.claim_2: The supplied 325 million paid-membership milestone is reported as the FY2025 annual average number of paid memberships.
claim_assertions.claim_3: The FY2026 target operating margin already includes the stated acquisition expenses.

definitions.regional_currency: Use the detailed thousand-dollar Q4 appendix, adding signed currency and hedging-exclusion adjustments. Prior growth denominator also excludes hedging.
definitions.annual_currency_margin: Recompute revenue and expense on the beginning-year FX basis by subtracting their respective FX-impact amounts from reported revenue and expense. These are effects included in reported figures, unlike the additive signed regional adjustments. operating_income_usd_thousand and reported_margin_pct in this table use reported revenue less reported expense, and that income divided by reported revenue. adjusted_operating_income_usd_thousand is beginning-year-FX revenue less beginning-year-FX expense. Margin-change basis points equal adjusted less reported margin. residual_usd_thousand is reconstructed adjusted operating income less the independent reported adjusted operating-income observation.
definitions.forecast_bounds: FY2026 forecasts are not actuals. Implied revenue growth uses the observed annual FY2025 revenue baseline. Implied operating growth uses the independent operating_income_usd_thousand observation in the annual_margin input table, not the reconstructed operating-income output of annual_currency_margin. Keep the reported baseline independent when revenue and expense disagree. The 31.5 percent target already includes the acquisition expense, so do not add it again.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient supporting source IDs for each output. IDs may appear alone or inside explanations, with multiple IDs in one entry. Explanation-only entries do not supply evidence. Every cited ID must be relevant and known. Additional unrelated sections fail. Prose is not an entailment check and cannot repair incorrect numbers.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
claim_policy: Supported means the supplied evidence entails the assertion. Contradicted means it entails the negation. Unresolved means neither follows. A claim that the supplied dossier explicitly reports a quantity is contradicted when the supplied scope explicitly omits it. A claim about the unknown economic quantity itself remains unresolved. Do not infer zero from missing information. No label count or order is promised.
text_policy: Text columns declare canonical values and accepted source-label aliases. Aliases refer to the same economic category, never a different period, unit or measure. Duplicate keys after normalization fail. Different SQL, row order and column order are accepted. Numeric tolerances are unchanged.
